title: Motion Detection Tuner
description: Frigate uses motion detection as a first line check to see if there is anything happening in the frame worth checking with object detection.

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.description: The threshold value dictates how much of a change in a pixel's luminance is required to be considered motion.

contour_area.label: Contour Area
contour_area.description: The contour area value is used to decide which groups of changed pixels qualify as motion.
